mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy accommodates economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and declines in INDPRO signal stagflationary pressures, causing equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% YoY and INDPRO falls > 0.3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A late-cycle expansion regime defined by strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) leads to profit-taking and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105 and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1200 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above 105 (index 2017=100) indicates robust supply conditions, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% signals monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market with unemployment rate below 3.0% generates wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.0%.
